input.sparql:
PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?zone ?zoneName ?point ?tsid ?class WHERE {
  ?ahu a brick:Air_Handling_Unit ; rdfs:label "AHU03" .
  ?ahu brick:feeds ?zone .
  OPTIONAL { ?zone rdfs:label ?zoneName }
  ?point brick:hasLocation ?zone ; a brick:Air_Temperature .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?x ; ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?point rdf:type ?class .
}
